article_manifest.title: Ségou: Three suspects arrested in connection with the murder of a young man in Markala
article_manifest.original_title: Ségou : trois suspects arrêtés dans l’affaire de l’assassinat d’un jeune homme à Markala
article_manifest.summary: Three suspects were arrested on Thursday 19 November 2026 as part of the investigation into the murder of a young man, which took place on 12 November in Markala, 35 km from Ségou. The victim had been killed on a construction site belonging to his brother. According to local sources, the suspects are being held at the gendarmerie.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Algerian secret services reportedly seeking to resume mediation with the FLA, according to Africa Intelligence
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : les services secrets algériens chercheraient à rétablir la médiation avec le FLA, selon Africa Intelligence
article_manifest.summary: The Algerian secret services are reportedly seeking to re-establish a channel of dialogue between the Malian authorities and the National Movement for the Liberation of Azawad (MNLA), according to Africa Intelligence. "As a new offensive by armed groups looms, the Algerian secret services are struggling to reactivate channels of mediation between the Malian state and the Tuareg rebels allied with the jihadists of GSIM," wrote the specialised media outlet on X, on 24 November 2026.

article_manifest.title: "Don't leave, stay in the country": Racky Aidara becomes a victim of cyberbullying after her advice
article_manifest.original_title: « Ne partez pas, restez au pays » : Racky Aidara victime de cyberharcèlement après ses conseils
article_manifest.summary: "Don't leave, stay in the country": Racky Aidara victim of cyberharassment after her advice Given the deaths in clandestine emigration in recent weeks, all Senegalese opinion leaders are talking about it and advising young people who are thinking of doing so. As the tragedies of clandestine emigration have multiplied in recent weeks, there are an increasing number of Senegalese voices calling on young people to give up on leaving.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: China-Solomon Islands: Beijing defends its cooperation in the Pacific
article_manifest.original_title: Chine-Îles Salomon : Pékin défend sa coopération dans le Pacifique
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 24 November (AMAP) China stated on Tuesday that its cooperation with Pacific island countries is not aimed at geopolitical competition or confrontation between blocs, amid reports of a possible non-renewal of its security agreement with the Solomon Islands. "China is developing its relations with the Solomon Islands on the basis of mutual respect and equality," said Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun at a press briefing in Beijing.

article_manifest.title: The Minister Delegate for Defence welcomes servicemen released from captivity
article_manifest.original_title: Le ministre délégué à la Défense reçoit des militaires libérés de captivité
article_manifest.summary: The Minister Delegate for Defence welcomes soldiers released from captivity General Oumar Diarra, Minister Delegate to the Minister of Defence, welcomed Malian soldiers recently released from captivity on 23 November 2026. These soldiers had been captured during the coordinated attacks of 25 April 2026, particularly in the Kidal region. According to Major General Elizée Jean Dao, Chief of Staff of the Army, their release is the result of a major operation carried out by the command.

article_manifest.title: Soldiers freed in Mali: spectacular raid by the FAMA and Africa Corps, or an operation carried out without fighting?
article_manifest.original_title: Militaires libérés au Mali : raid spectaculaire des Fama et d’Africa Corps ou opération menée sans combat ?
article_manifest.summary: Soldiers freed in Mali: spectacular raid by the FAMa and Africa Corps, or operation carried out without a fight? On 18 November, the Malian army and its Russian partners announced that they had freed 24 soldiers being held near Kidal. But behind the spectacular images released by Africa Corps, the reality of the operation is said to be less heroic.

article_manifest.title: Urban security: around thirty unlicensed taxis seized during an inspection operation in Niamey
article_manifest.original_title: Sécurité urbaine : une trentaine de taxis clandestins saisis lors d’une opération de contrôle à Niamey
article_manifest.summary: As part of its efforts to regulate and make urban transport safer, the Urban Transport Department of the City of Niamey (DTU) carried out an operation this weekend to check and sweep for vehicles operating without regulatory authorisation, particularly in markets and busy areas of the capital. The operation, which covered several neighbourhoods and junctions in the capital, resulted in the seizure of vehicles used for the illegal transport of people, including around thirty unlicensed taxis.

article_manifest.title: OPERATION DOUGOUKOLOKO: The FAMa [Malian Armed Forces] are stepping up security operations in Diabaly, Anefis, Tonka and Indelimane
article_manifest.original_title: OPÉRATION DOUGOUKOLOKO : Les FAMa intensifient les opérations de sécurisation à Diabaly, Anéfis, Tonka et Indelimane
article_manifest.summary: Several terrorist groups neutralised, vehicles and motorcycles destroyed: The Malian Armed Forces continue their surveillance, reconnaissance and security operations on several fronts across the national territory. Illustrative image BAMADA.NET – The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are resolutely continuing their missions to defend and protect the national territory.

article_manifest.title: Mali – FAMa: 24 soldiers freed from the hands of the enemy following an airborne operation; General Oumar Diarra commends their resilience
article_manifest.original_title: Mali – FAMa : 24 militaires libérés des mains de l’ennemi après une opération aéroportée, le général Oumar Diarra salue leur résilience
article_manifest.summary: MALI: GENERAL OUMAR DIARRA ENCOURAGES SOLDIERS RELEASED AFTER THEIR CAPTIVITY – THE FAMa REAFFIRM THEIR COMMITMENT TO SERVING THE NATION Lieutenant General Élisée Jean Dao, Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces, at the reception for the 24 released FAMa soldiers, 23 November 2023 . Bamada.net – Military solidarity, loyalty to the homeland and determination to defend Mali's territorial integrity were the focus of a particularly important meeting on Monday, 23 November 2026.

article_manifest.title: Purchasing power in Mali: The transitional authorities' successful offensive brings down the price of meat
article_manifest.original_title: Pouvoir d’achat au Mali : l’offensive gagnante des autorités de transition fait chuter le prix de la viande
article_manifest.summary: In the face of the high cost of living, which was weighing heavily on household budgets, the government's strategy is finally bearing fruit. Gathered in Bamako on Monday, 16 November 2026, around the Minister of Industry and Trade, Moussa Alassane Diallo, stakeholders in the livestock-meat sector welcomed a significant drop in prices at market stalls, a direct result of the courageous decisions taken by the Transitional Authorities.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso: Vivo Energy simulates an accident between two tankers to test its safety system
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso : Vivo Energy simule un accident entre deux camions pour tester son dispositif de sécurité
article_manifest.summary: An accident involving a tanker carrying fuel and a gas tanker, followed by the outbreak of a fire and the treatment of casualties. This was the full-scale scenario that the teams from Vivo Energy Burkina and their partners took part in on Thursday, 19 November 2026, at the company's gas depot in Bingo. .

article_manifest.title: Algerian soldiers in the Niger desert... from withdrawing ambassadors to crossing borders
article_manifest.original_title: جنود الجزائر في صحراء النيجر.. من سحب السفراء إلى عبور الحدود
article_manifest.summary: On Friday, 30 October 2026, circulating images showed an Algerian convoy near the customs office in the town of Arlit in northwestern Niger, comprising dozens of fuel tankers and guarded by military vehicles. Reuters quoted ten sources as saying that the first Algerian military convoy had arrived in the town, located about 200 kilometres from the border, marking the first publicly announced deployment of Algerian forces outside the country since the October 1973 war.

article_manifest.title: THE SECURITIES OF 23 NOVEMBER 2026
article_manifest.summary: - The 31st Conference of the Parties on Climate Change concluded last Friday in Antalya, Türkiye. At the end of ten days of discussions, observers consider the outcome to be disappointing. - Several towns in the country were targeted by armed men last Saturday in Niono, Bandiagara and Gao.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The army announces strikes in four sectors
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : l'armée annonce des frappes dans quatre secteurs
article_manifest.summary: The Malian army claims to have carried out several operations on Sunday, 22 November 2026 in the sectors of Diabaly, Anéfis, Tonka and Indelimane. According to a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces, these operations resulted in the neutralisation of several terrorists and the destruction of vehicles and motorbikes. .

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso–Mali military cooperation: Burkinabé trainee officers immersed in Malian military institutions
article_manifest.original_title: Coopération militaire Burkina-Mali : Des officiers stagiaires burkinabè en immersion auprès des institutions militaires maliennes
article_manifest.summary: On Friday, 20 November 2026, the trainee officers of the 2nd class of the Burkina Faso Staff College carried out a series of visits to several Malian military institutions, as part of their study trip to Mali. The information was made public by the Malian Armed Forces . The delegation visited, in particular, the Directorate of Military Colleges, the General Staff of the Armed Forces and the Ministry of Defence and Veterans' Affairs.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso/Agriculture: A fire destroys more than four hectares of rice in Bossora
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina/Agriculture : Un incendie détruit plus de quatre hectares de riz à Bossora
article_manifest.summary: A fire ravaged more than four hectares of rice in a field in Bossora, a village in the municipality of Satiri, in the Houet Province, on Friday, 20 November 2026, according to our colleagues at the AIB. The fire caused significant losses for the producers, although its exact circumstances are not yet known. .

article_manifest.title: Handling JNIM’s Threat to the Sahel’s Urban Heartlands
article_manifest.original_title: Handling JNIM’s Threat to the Sahel’s Urban Heartlands
article_manifest.summary: Over the last few years, the al-Qaeda affiliate in the Sahel has staged ever more daring assaults on the region’s cities. Pursuing military victory over the jihadists would further raise the steep human cost. Exploring a negotiated solution may prove the least harmful option.

article_manifest.title: Occupied Palestinian Territory Emergency Response Activity Update #61, 1 - 31 October 2026 [EN/AR]
article_manifest.original_title: Occupied Palestinian Territory Emergency Response Activity Update #61, 1 - 31 October 2026 [EN/AR]
article_manifest.summary: SITUATION OVERVIEW October marked both one year since the October 2025 ceasefire and three years since the escalation of hostilities. The humanitarian situation in Gaza remains dire and extremely fragile, with humanitarian partners warning that funding shortfalls, combined with ongoing Israeli restrictions, have begun to reverse the gains achieved since the ceasefire was announced.
